scheme_name: Scheme for Grant of Financial Assistance to Industrial Workers/Employee for Purchase of Spectacles
other_conditions: Applicant must be covered under clause (C) of Section 2 of the Goa, Daman and Diu Labour Welfare Fund Act, 1986
Applicant must have completed one year of service in the industrial establishment on the date of application, including broken spells of service
Applicant must get eyes tested in State Hospitals, Goa Medical College, or by a qualified optician
Applicant must obtain the lens number for the spectacles
benefits_summary: Financial assistance up to ₹2,000 for the frame and lenses; replacement allowed after five years (or after one year for lens change, up to ₹400).
documents_required: Copies of mandatory documents (self‑attested if required)
